name: hc-state
description: CLI tool for querying holochain over admin port

scripts.run:test: hc s clean && concurrently "AGENTS=1 BOOTSTRAP_PORT=11222 SIGNAL_PORT=11223 yarn hc:run" "yarn api:test"; clear:all
scripts.hc:run: concurrently "hc run-local-services --bootstrap-port $BOOTSTRAP_PORT --signal-port $SIGNAL_PORT" "echo pass | RUST_LOG=debug hc sandbox -f 8888 generate --app-id my-test-app --num-sandboxes $AGENTS --root ./ --directories test-agent --run 0 ./test.happ network webrtc ws://127.0.0.1:"$SIGNAL_PORT""
scripts.clear:all: hc s clean; yarn clear:lair; yarn clear:hc
